name: support-console
description: Resolve telecom support-console decision tasks where the user provides a batch or queue payload (CSV/JSON), a strict JSON answer template, and a shared REST API at the TASK_ENV_BASE_URL for gathering evidence. Use this skill whenever the task involves service tickets, mobile support cases, enterprise incident investigations, or queue-quality classification that references a support-console API, even if the user does not explicitly name the console.
